authority.inferred_mechanism: The south-facing sticky base (0,1,5), head (0,1,6) and redstone payload (0,1,7) start extended. Down-facing observer (0,2,5), initially unpowered, watches the base; its pulse supplies reset through cap (0,3,5). A falling input withdraws the payload and removes the raw output's power. Observer reset re-extends it, then loss of reset power permits another internal cycle while the root input remains low.
